# MirrorSite AI

> Instant full-stack code and web generation powered by ATAI Enterprises.

MirrorSite AI is an AI-powered application development platform that turns websites and ideas into working full-stack applications. It analyzes a starting point — an idea, a product concept, or an existing website — structures what needs to be built, and generates a complete application foundation including frontend, backend, authentication, database, and infrastructure.

## Key Features

- AI-powered application planning and generation
- Website analysis and structure extraction
- Full-stack code generation (React, Next.js, Node.js)
- Authentication, database, and backend included
- Managed infrastructure and deployment
- Credit-based pricing with transparent tiers

## Pricing

- Explorer: $12/month — 50,000 credits
- Starter: $79/month — 300,000 credits
- Business: $139/month — 600,000 credits
- Professional: $219/month — 1,400,000 credits
- Enterprise: $499+/month — 5,000,000+ credits

Application build costs:
- Simple: 50,000 credits — basic website/application generation
- Medium: 75,000 credits — multi-page apps with auth and database
- Complex: 100,000 credits — advanced full-stack projects
